title: Choose the Orbital Registry composition
question: The world is locked. Which first-viewport composition should govern the Mars Bank logo, tokens, and site-wide theme?

options.label: Plotted Horizon
options.thesis: The bank is a survey station: balances lock to a plotted horizon.
options.viewport: Nav lockup, left headline and login, right film registry, horizon grid across the fold.
options.risk: The plotted field can overwhelm the logo if the lockup stays too small.

options.label: Civic Plate
options.thesis: The mark is the institution: a civic registry plate that banking actions stamp.
options.viewport: Oversized lockup and monogram plate own the first screen; services sit as hairline cells below.
options.risk: Strong identity, weaker immediate account-management story.

options.label: Coordinate Sheet
options.thesis: Keep the split banking page, recast as one survey sheet.
options.viewport: Graphite copy column, plotted right field, oxide login on the seam.
options.risk: Closest to the old Macquarie split, so the new world has to work harder in details.
